propositions: rebar-brainstorm/SKILL.md currently instructs authors to run plan-review on each ticket immediately after creation before dependency links exist, contradicting actual gate behavior
plan-review gate fast-fails with exit 2 INDETERMINATE on blocked tickets not yet claimable, requiring reviews to run in dependency order only on unblocked tickets

rebar-brainstorm/SKILL.md must be rewritten to establish child dependency graph first via blocks/depends_on links, then run plan-review only on unblocked tickets identified by rebar ready in dependency order
rebar-brainstorm/SKILL.md must specify fallback behavior when rebar ready returns empty set to detect and resolve dependency cycle or authoring error
rebar-implement/SKILL.md already correctly treats dependency graph as precondition and uses rebar ready/next-batch to claim and review only unblocked dependency-ordered tickets
